info.title: SUMA Tracking Tool API
info.description: Enterprise ITSM, SLA, Attendance & Security platform. Base path /api/v1.

post.summary: Terminate an active session (revokes refresh tokens, closes attendance with source ADMIN_TERMINATED)
Mark the Project Lead report email as verified (or unverified). Monthly reports are only sent to verified recipients.
Create integration. Credentials are encrypted at rest and never returned.
Rotate refresh token and obtain a new access token
End the current session (idempotent). source=BROWSER_UNLOAD for best-effort tab-close beacons.

post.description: Returns an access token; the refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie. Every attempt is recorded with source IP.

post.summary: Generate and send a monthly report for a completed month (fails with 409 if that period was already generated)
Re-send a monthly report. Already-delivered reports require force=true (audited).
End the current attendance session and sign out
Attendance check-in for the current login (idempotent). Attendance is recorded automatically at sign-in; this returns the active session.
Report that the configured in-app inactivity threshold was reached (idempotent per session)
Employee confirms status after an inactivity prompt: WORKING, ON_BREAK or AWAY
Browser heartbeat with last in-app activity time (used for disconnect and idle detection)
Administrative correction. The original value is preserved in the correction record and audit log.

get.summary: type: productivity, sla, pending, ageing, client, project, team, daily, weekly, monthly
Attendance dashboard (scoped): logged in, active, on break, idle, missing logouts, compliance, live status
Today's attendance for the signed-in employee: login time, status, breaks, idle events, exceptions
Attendance history: login, logout, break start/end, idle start/end, confirmations, reminders, corrections
